title: Hunt loot stored by Trade's receiver at Node Beta sold where it lies
note: 2026-11-22 07:37 UTC (Mercury): orders ENT-062, block MERCURY and P5: a sell route at a station where our hunts hand their loot to Trade's receiver (data/fleet/receivers.json; hunt routes with gift_to trader and sell_at here). With strict classes on the hunt gives every good into the receiver's storage here; this route withdraws what sells and sells it at the floors, then stores what the bids left. Evidence: hunts with sell_at here took 32 superfluid vials in 24 h and sold none; book 2026-11-22 07:33 UTC: superfluid 697 x 50 (depth 96). requires.stored sends only a pilot whose own storage here holds 10 superfluid_vial; requires.bid closes it while a book read within the hour shows no superfluid_vial bid at 650. Floors at or near the standing NPC bids, never under a standing bid (F12); goods without a bid above 25 cr (carapace, raw xeno meat, crystallized biogas, fusion pearl, levity bladder) stay stored. Nothing is bought. A test: one ship (F37: three results decide). 2026-11-22 07:40 UTC (Mercury): off before its first run: reservecheck.py flags superfluid vial as held back for the recipe superfluid_winding (control_node), rule F24; on again when the hold-back is gone.
